Hate Violence Map

Killings, attacks and other violence against people for who they are: hate crimes, violence against women, lynchings and police killings, massacres, camps and genocide, past and present.

Years shownevery year
Applies to every layer that is on: dated points, and the year each country shading uses. Each layer also has its own years under it.

How it is drawn

Filled dot: placed where the source, or the address it gives, puts it Ring: an estimated or uncertain spot, usually a record spread inside the town, county or country its source names; the layer and its box say which Shaded country or area: one shading at a time; ticking another turns the first off

Where several records share one spot, they are drawn slightly apart in a small spiral so each can be clicked; each box says so. Where dots still overlap at a zoom, a click lists every one under it.
